summary: Batch data-import counterpart of CBEXPORT. Reads the multi-record export file, routes each record to the correct output master file based on its record-type code (customer, account, cross-reference, transaction, card), logs unknown record types to an error file, and reports per-entity import counts. Validates the import at the end.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN-PROCESSING
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize, process the export file record by record, validate the import, and finalize. Return.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build the import date/time stamp from CURRENT-DATE and open all files.

paragraphs.name: 1100-OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the export file for input and the customer, account, cross-reference, transaction, card and error files for output; abend if any open fails.

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS-EXPORT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the export file until EOF; for each record, count it and process it by record type.

paragraphs.name: 2100-READ-EXPORT-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next export record; abend on a non-OK/non-EOF status.
branches: IF NOT WS-EXPORT-OK AND NOT WS-EXPORT-EOF -> abend

paragraphs.name: 2200-PROCESS-RECORD-BY-TYPE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Examine the record-type code and route the record to the matching output writer: customer, account, cross-reference, transaction or card. Any unrecognized type is written to the error file and counted as an unknown record type.
branches: EVALUATE record type -> customer / account / xref / transaction / card / WHEN OTHER (unknown)

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: each export record is dispatched to a master file by its record-type code; unknown types are logged as errors, not loaded.

paragraphs.name: 2300-WRITE-CUSTOMER
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write a customer master record from the export record; count it as a customer imported.

paragraphs.name: 2400-WRITE-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write an account master record from the export record; count it as an account imported.

paragraphs.name: 2500-WRITE-XREF
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write a cross-reference record from the export record; count it as an xref imported.

paragraphs.name: 2600-WRITE-TRANSACTION
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write a transaction record from the export record; count it as a transaction imported.

paragraphs.name: 2700-WRITE-CARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write a card record from the export record; count it as a card imported.

paragraphs.name: 2900-WRITE-ERROR-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write an error record (timestamp, record type, sequence, message) to the error file for a record that could not be imported; count it.

paragraphs.name: 3000-VALIDATE-IMPORT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the import (e.g. compare records read vs records written per type) and report any discrepancies.

annotations.note: Import validation step; exact reconciliation rules not fully visible -- flag for SME confirmation.

paragraphs.name: 4000-FINALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close all files and display the per-entity import counts, error count and unknown-type count.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Display an abend message and terminate the program abnormally.
